description: This file defines an abstract class 'Formatter' for formatting SCSS code, including handling indentation, block styles, source maps, and properties. It is part of the SCSSPHP library.

classes.name: Formatter
classes.description: An abstract base class for formatting SCSS code into CSS, managing indentation, blocks, source maps, and output formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Abstract constructor to initialize formatter properties.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns the indentation string based on indent level and character.

methods.name: customProperty
methods.description: Formats a custom property assignment, preserving spaces.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Outputs an entire block, including selectors, lines, and children.

methods.name: testEmptyChildren
methods.description: Recursively tests if a block's children are empty.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Main entry point to format a block, optionally with a source map generator.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Outputs strings, handling source map updates and semi-colon stripping.
